errors.questionText: Which of the following statement about stoptober is false?

options.A: It is an official organization administered by the UK authorities.
options.B: It contributes to the decrease in the number of smokers in the UK.
options.C: It encourages people to stop smoking through a variety of channels.
options.D: It inspired Samantha Griffiths to give up smoking.

errors.questionText: Which of the following measures have the UK authorities adopted to control the amount of smokers?

options.A: Those who quit smoking were granted a free trip to Paris Disneyland.
options.B: A tax as heavy as that in Australia was imposed on a tobacco products.
options.C: The use of green color is totally forbidden in the packing of cigarettes.
options.D: Regular-sized cigarette were not permitted to be sold throughout the UK.

errors.questionText: Which of the following can best explain the last sentence "fortunately China has a Disneyland of its own."

options.A: Patriotic China citizens will visit their own Disneyland rather than go abroad.

options.C: The strict no-smoking policy is gladly being implemented in China's Disneyland.
options.D: Tourists are entitled to purchasing less expensive cigarettes in China's Disneyland.
